def format_vulnerability(vulnerability: Any, full_mode: bool, only_text:
    bool=False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns) ->str:
    lines = []
    req = vulnerability.pkg.requirements[0] if vulnerability.pkg.requirements else None
    is_pinned = is_pinned_requirement(req.specifier) if req else True

    if is_pinned:
        header = f'-> Vulnerability found in {vulnerability.pkg.name} version {vulnerability.pkg.version}'
    else:
        spec_str = str(req.specifier) if req else ''
        header = f'-> Vulnerability may be present given that your {vulnerability.pkg.name} install specifier is\n   {spec_str}'

    lines.append(header)
    lines.append(f'   Vulnerability ID: {vulnerability.vulnerability_id}')

    if vulnerability.ignored:
        ignored_expires = vulnerability.ignored_expires
        if ignored_expires:
            expires_str = ignored_expires.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')
            ignore_line = f'   This vulnerability is being ignored until {expires_str}. See your configurations.'
        else:
            ignore_line = '   This vulnerability is being ignored.'
        lines.append(ignore_line)

        if vulnerability.ignored_reason:
            lines.append(f'   Reason: {vulnerability.ignored_reason}')

        if columns >= 120:
            lines.append(f'   For more information about this vulnerability, visit {vulnerability.more_info_url}')
        else:
            lines.append(f'   For more information about this vulnerability, visit')
            lines.append(f'   {vulnerability.more_info_url}')
        lines.append('')
        result = '\n'.join(lines)
        return click.unstyle(result) if only_text else result

    lines.append(f'   Affected spec: {vulnerability.affected_versions}')
    lines.append(f'   ADVISORY: {vulnerability.advisory}')

    fixed_versions = vulnerability.fixed_versions
    if fixed_versions:
        fixed_str = ', '.join(fixed_versions)
    else:
        fixed_str = 'No known fix'
    lines.append(f'   Fixed versions: {fixed_str}')

    cve = vulnerability.CVE
    if cve:
        cvssv3 = cve.cvssv3
        cvssv2 = cve.cvssv2
        severity = cve.cvssv3.get('base_severity', '') if cvssv3 else ''
        
        if cvssv3:
            base_score_v3 = cvssv3.get('base_score', '')
            impact_score_v3 = cvssv3.get('impact_score', '')
            vector_v3 = cvssv3.get('vector_string', '')
            severity_line = f'   {vulnerability.pkg.name} is {severity} SEVERITY => CVSS v3, BASE SCORE {base_score_v3}, IMPACT'
            lines.append(severity_line)
            score_line = f'   SCORE {impact_score_v3}, VECTOR STRING {vector_v3}'
            lines.append(score_line)

        if cvssv2:
            base_score_v2 = cvssv2.get('base_score', '')
            impact_score_v2 = cvssv2.get('impact_score', '')
            vector_v2 = cvssv2.get('vector_string', '')
            lines.append(f'   CVSS v2, BASE SCORE {base_score_v2}, IMPACT SCORE {impact_score_v2}, VECTOR STRING')
            lines.append(f'   {vector_v2}')

    if not is_pinned:
        lines.append(f'   This vulnerability is present in your install specifier range.')
        lines.append(f'   To learn more about reporting these, specifier range handling, and')
        lines.append(f'   options for scanning unpinned packages visit')
        lines.append(f'   https://docs.pyup.io/docs/safety-range-specs')

    lines.append(f'   For more information about this vulnerability, visit')
    lines.append(f'   {vulnerability.more_info_url}')
    lines.append(f'   To ignore this vulnerability, use PyUp vulnerability id {vulnerability.vulnerability_id} in')
    lines.append(f'   safety\u2019s ignore command-line argument or add the ignore to your safety')
    lines.append(f'   policy file.\n')

    result = '\n'.join(lines)
    return click.unstyle(result) if only_text else result

def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    result = []
    result.append('   REMEDIATIONS')

    using_api_key = is_using_api_key()

    if not using_api_key:
        total_vulns = sum(
            spec_data.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
            for pkg_data in remediations.values()
            for spec_data in pkg_data.values()
        )
        total_pkgs = len(remediations)
        content = f'\n  {total_vulns} vulnerabilit{"y was" if total_vulns == 1 else "ies were"} reported in {total_pkgs} package{"" if total_pkgs == 1 else "s"}. For detailed remediation & fix \n  recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license. \n'
        result.append(content)
    else:
        content_lines = []
        for pkg_name, specs in remediations.items():
            for spec, data in specs.items():
                vulns_found = data.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
                version = data.get('version', '')
                recommended_version = data.get('recommended_version', None)
                closest_secure = data.get('closest_secure_version', {})
                other_recommended = data.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
                more_info_url = data.get('more_info_url', '')

                section = f'\n-> {pkg_name} version {version} was found, which has {vulns_found} vulnerabilit{"y" if vulns_found == 1 else "ies"}\n'

                if recommended_version:
                    upper = closest_secure.get('upper', recommended_version)
                    section += f'   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {upper}\n'

                padding = ' ' * 78
                section += f'{padding}\n'

                if recommended_version:
                    section += f'   We recommend updating to version {recommended_version} of {pkg_name}.'
                    if other_recommended:
                        other_str = ', '.join(str(v) for v in other_recommended)
                        section += f' Other versions\n   without known vulnerabilities are: {other_str}\n'
                    else:
                        section += '\n'

                section += f'{padding}\n'
                section += f'   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit\n'
                section += f'   {more_info_url}\n'
                section += f'   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.\n'
                section += f'{padding}'

                content_lines.append(section)

        result.append(''.join(content_lines))

    result.append('+' + '=' * 78 + '+')
    return result

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if columns:
        width = columns - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator) - len(indent)
        if width < 1:
            width = 1
        wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
            width=width,
            initial_indent=indent,
            subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent,
            break_long_words=False,
            break_on_hyphens=False
        )
        wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(text)
        if not wrapped_lines:
            wrapped_lines = [indent + text]
    else:
        wrapped_lines = [indent + text]

    result_lines = []
    for line in wrapped_lines:
        result_lines.append(f'{start_line_decorator}{line}{end_line_decorator}')

    result = '\n'.join(result_lines)

    if color and not styling:
        result = click.style(result, fg=color)
    elif styling:
        result = click.style(result, **styling)

    return result
```

def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    styled_items = []
    plain_items = []

    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        scanned_paths = ctx.scanned_full_path if hasattr(ctx, 'scanned_full_path') else []
        if not scanned_paths:
            msg = 'No locations found in the environment'
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': msg}]]
            plain_items = [msg]
        else:
            for path in scanned_paths:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {path}'}])
                plain_items.append(path)
    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file', None)
        if file_obj:
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}]]
            plain_items = [file_obj.name]
    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        for f in files:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {f.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(f.name)
    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        packages = ctx.packages if hasattr(ctx, 'packages') else []
        if not packages:
            msg = 'No found packages in stdin'
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': msg}]]
            plain_items = [msg]
        else:
            for pkg in packages:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
                plain_items.append(pkg.name)

    return styled_items, plain_items
```

        vulns_text = f'{total_vulns_found} vulnerabilit{"y" if total_vulns_found == 1 else "ies"} found'
    else:
        vulns_text = 'No known security vulnerabilities found'

    brief_text = f' {vulns_text}'

    if total_ignored > 0:
        brief_text += f', {total_ignored} ignored'

    if remediations_count > 0:
        brief_text += f', {remediations_count} remediations suggested'

    brief_text += ' '

    return format_long_text(brief_text, start_line_decorator=' ', **kwargs)

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if columns:
        width = columns - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator) - len(indent)
        if width < 1:
            width = 1
        wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
            width=width,
            initial_indent=indent,
            subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent,
            break_long_words=False,
            break_on_hyphens=False
        )
        wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(text)
        if not wrapped_lines:
            wrapped_lines = [indent + text]
    else:
        wrapped_lines = [indent + text]

    result_lines = []
    for line in wrapped_lines:
        result_lines.append(f'{start_line_decorator}{line}{end_line_decorator}')

    result = '\n'.join(result_lines)

    if color and not styling:
        result = click.style(result, fg=color)
    elif styling:
        result = click.style(result, **styling)

    return result

def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    styled_items = []
    plain_items = []

    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        scanned_paths = ctx.scanned_full_path if hasattr(ctx, 'scanned_full_path') else []
        if not scanned_paths:
            msg = 'No locations found in the environment'
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': msg}]]
            plain_items = [msg]
        else:
            for path in scanned_paths:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {path}'}])
                plain_items.append(path)
    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file', None)
        if file_obj:
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}]]
            plain_items = [file_obj.name]
    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        for f in files:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {f.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(f.name)
    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        packages = ctx.packages if hasattr(ctx, 'packages') else []
        if not packages:
            msg = 'No found packages in stdin'
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': msg}]]
            plain_items = [msg]
        else:
            for pkg in packages:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
                plain_items.append(pkg.name)

    return styled_items, plain_items

def build_report_brief_section(columns: Optional[int]=None,
    primary_announcement: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, report_type: int=1,
    **kwargs: Any) ->str:
    brief_info = get_report_brief_info(as_dict=False, report_type=report_type, **kwargs)

    if not columns:
        columns = get_terminal_size().columns

    lines = []

    for info_line in brief_info:
        line_text = ''
        for word in info_line:
            value = word.get('value', '')
            style = word.get('style', False)
            if style:
                value = click.style(value, bold=True)
            line_text += value
        lines.append(line_text)

    section = '\n'.join(lines)

    if primary_announcement:
        try:
            announcement_content = build_primary_announcement(primary_announcement, columns=columns)
            section = announcement_content + '\n' + section
        except Exception:
            pass

    return section

def build_using_sentence(account: Optional[str], key: Optional[str], db:
    Optional[str]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if db:
        return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using a local database from: '},
                {'style': True, 'value': db}]
    elif key or account:
        return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using your '},
                {'style': True, 'value': 'API Key'},
                {'style': False, 'value': ' to query Safety\'s vulnerability database'}]
    else:
        return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using the '},
                {'style': True, 'value': 'open-source vulnerability database'},
                {'style': False, 'value': ' (synced in real-time)'}]

def build_scanned_count_sentence(packages: List[Package]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]
    ]:
    count = len(packages) if packages else 0
    return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Found '},
            {'style': True, 'value': str(count)},
            {'style': False, 'value': f' package{"s" if count != 1 else ""} in your environment'}]

def get_report_brief_info(as_dict: bool=False, report_type: int=1, **kwargs:
    Any):
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    packages = ctx.packages
    
    if report_type == 2:
        return build_report_for_review_vuln_report(as_dict=as_dict)

    if as_dict:
        telemetry = build_telemetry_data(telemetry=kwargs.get('telemetry', True))
        git = build_git_data()
        now = str(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))
        
        result = {
            'safety_version': get_safety_version(),
            'timestamp': now,
            'packages_found': len(packages) if packages else 0,
            'api_key': bool(ctx.key),
            'local_database_path_used': ctx.db_mirror if is_a_remote_mirror(ctx.db_mirror) is False else None,
            'telemetry': telemetry,
            'git': git,
        }
        
        scanning_target = ctx.params.get('scanning_target', None)
        if scanning_target:
            _, scanned_items = get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target)
            result['scanned'] = scanned_items
            result['scan_target'] = scanning_target
        
        policy_file = ctx.params.get('policy_file', None)
        if policy_file:
            result['policy_file'] = policy_file.name if hasattr(policy_file, 'name') else policy_file
        
        return result

    scanning_target = ctx.params.get('scanning_target', 'environment')
    
    policy_file = ctx.params.get('policy_file', None)
    safety_policy_used = []
    if policy_file:
        policy_name = policy_file.name if hasattr(policy_file, 'name') else str(policy_file)
        safety_policy_used = [
            {'style': False, 'value': '\nScanning using a security policy file'},
            {'style': True, 'value': ' {0}'.format(policy_name)},
        ]

    action_executed = [
        {'style': True, 'value': 'Scanning dependencies'},
        {'style': False, 'value': ' in your '},
        {'style': True, 'value': str(scanning_target) + ':'},
    ]

    scanned_items_styled, _ = get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target)

    nl = [{'style': False, 'value': ''}]
    using_sentence = build_using_sentence(ctx.account,
                                          ctx.key,
                                          ctx.db_mirror if not is_a_remote_mirror(ctx.db_mirror) else None)
    scanned_count_sentence = build_scanned_count_sentence(packages)
    now = str(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))
    timestamp = [{'style': False, 'value': 'Timestamp '}, {'style': True, 'value': now}]

    brief_info = [[{'style': False, 'value': 'Safety '},
                   {'style': True, 'value': 'v' + get_safety_version()},
                   {'style': False, 'value': ' is scanning for '},
                   {'style': True, 'value': 'Vulnerabilities'},
                   {'style': True, 'value': '...'}] + safety_policy_used,
                  action_executed
                  ] + [nl] + scanned_items_styled + [nl] + [using_sentence] + [scanned_count_sentence] + [timestamp]

    add_warnings_if_needed(brief_info)

    return brief_info

def format_unpinned_vulnerabilities(unpinned_packages: Dict[str, List[Any]],
    columns: Optional[int]=None) ->List[str]:
    result = []
    
    if not unpinned_packages:
        return result
    
    for pkg_name, vulns in unpinned_packages.items():
        if not vulns:
            continue
        vuln_count = len(vulns)
        affected_versions = []
        for v in vulns:
            if hasattr(v, 'affected_versions'):
                affected_versions.extend(v.affected_versions if v.affected_versions else [])
        
        msg = (f'Warning: {vuln_count} known {"vulnerability" if vuln_count == 1 else "vulnerabilities"} '
               f'match the {pkg_name} versions that could be')
        result.append(msg)
    
    return result
